description: All-expert routing conflicts with the fused path's fixed selected-expert buffer count.
trigger: Call BlockSparseMLP.forward with one flattened token, fully EXL3 experts, activate_all_experts=True, and num_experts different from num_experts_per_tok.
expected_behavior: Evaluate every expert, or select the ordinary path that supports all-expert evaluation.
actual_behavior: Routing produces num_experts indices, but fused buffers retain num_experts_per_tok entries. The first exl3_mgemm call encounters its index-count/output-dimension check. Parent-tree searches found no pre-existing BlockSparseMLP construction; inspected decoder methods forward params to their supplied MLP, and conversion introduces the flag. This establishes a conditional API failure, not that default conversion reaches it.

verification.description: Compared routing cardinality, fused allocations and the native shape check, and inspected decoder forwarding sites.
For eight experts and two selected experts, modeled indices as (1,8) against fused output expert dimension 2; ordinary routing's corresponding equality holds and all-expert routing's fails.
verification.limits: Standard-library integer shape arithmetic, not tensor allocation or a kernel test.
